object_description: large triangular pancake beneath a shed roof
design_condition: The equilateral triangular volume is aligned with the hospital extension, Route d'Hérens and the eastern park, but its finite geometry raises questions about its proximity to the road and its fit within the site.

positive.statement: The radical principle of interior spatial organization caught the jury's attention.

position.rationale: Interior organization is approximated within the triangular plan; internal subdivisions are not distinguishable in the exterior point cloud.

positive.statement: The streets, alleys, squares and small squares create an attractive interior world.

position.target: streets, alleys, squares and small squares
position.rationale: The interior-world elements are placed in the central triangular plan, though individual streets and squares are not visible.

negative.statement: The roads and houses are more restrictive than they initially appear and offer little flexibility.

position.rationale: Circulation and housing are approximated because the sampled exterior does not distinguish internal roads or houses.

negative.statement: The triangular shape makes it difficult to inscribe the program, with oblique encounters questioning the formal premise.

position.rationale: The triangular footprint is clearly visible in plan and its thin profile is corroborated by all elevations.

negative.statement: The triangular shape does not convince in its integration into the site or its capacity to accommodate the program.

position.rationale: The project mass is visible, but surrounding site relationships are absent; the anchor uses the triangle’s central footprint.

negative.statement: The project does not take sustainable-development principles into account.

position.rationale: This is a global sustainability judgment without a specific geometric referent.

negative.statement: The volume is larger than average and has a very high form factor.

position.rationale: The broad triangular volume is directly visible in plan, while elevations confirm its very thin profile.

negative.statement: Embodied energy consumption would be very high because of the non-compact project, heavily glazed facades and glass-and-steel roof.

position.rationale: Embodied energy is a performance judgment, even though glazing, compactness and roof construction are cited as causes.
